# Concrete volume calculator

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/concrete-volume/

Calculate concrete volume for a slab, cylinder or rectangular footing. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Estimate the volume of a 5 m by 4 m slab that is 0.12 m thick and add a chosen allowance.

## Limits and checks

This is geometric volume, not a structural design or a concrete mix specification. Check construction requirements with a qualified professional.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
